data.one_liner: Unofficial Linux implementation of the gal plugin for saving images and videos.
data.what_it_does: Provides an unofficial Linux implementation of the gal plugin to save images and videos. It relies on standard command-line executables and handles file operations on Linux.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter app for Linux that needs to save media using the gal API
You require a federated Linux platform implementation alongside the gal package
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Linux
Your target Linux environment lacks standard utilities like wget, mkdir, mv, rm, and xdg-open
strengths: Enables gal plugin support on Linux
Copies files instead of moving them for putImage and putVideo
weaknesses: Non-endorsed federated plugin where internal gal changes can cause breaking changes
Limited support for opening the gallery, permissions, and access checks due to Linux fragmentation
Requires external command-line executables like wget to be available
data.setup_notes: Add both gal and gal_linux to pubspec.yaml. Ensure required executables like wget are installed on the Linux system.
